name: Runemaster audit: Runic Invocation lets Hoarfrost's periodic damage critically strike (#3664)
contract: Runic Invocation 807204 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE), EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = +10, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 8388608, matching Hoarfrost 801104's SpellFamilyFlags word 0 bit 23 (8388608) exactly. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT (286) on the same classmask. Verification note: the spell_done_crit_chance metric (Unit::SpellDoneCritChance, skipEffectCheck=false) is the wrong probe here - it gates on SpellInfo::IsCritCapable(), which only recognizes a direct SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE/HEAL/... effect TYPE, not an APPLY_AURA effect whose aura subtype is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE; Hoarfrost's own damage is delivered entirely through such a periodic aura (effect 1), so IsCritCapable() is false for it and that metric always reads 0, with or without the talent. The real periodic-tick crit computation is AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1175), called from CalculatePeriodicData on aura (re)application: it only computes a nonzero crit chance at all if the caster carries a SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT aura matching the ticking spell's classmask (exactly Runic Invocation's effect 1) - without that match critChance stays 0 regardless of crit rating, and with it SpellDoneCritChance is called with skipEffectCheck=true, picking up Runic Invocation's own SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE bonus. This follows the established house pattern from apps/coa-gameplay-test/scenarios/runemaster-leyfrost.json: maximize melee_crit_rating and observe spell_damage_count with critical:true across a fresh Hoarfrost application, before and after learning the talent.

steps.label: SETUP: even with max crit rating, Hoarfrost cannot crit without the talent
SETUP: the first Hoarfrost expires, so the next one ticks on a fresh application
CONTRACT: with Runic Invocation, Hoarfrost's periodic damage critically strikes
